# NextVisa

NextVisa is a visa assistance and travel service brand based in Kazakhstan, with a focus on helping travelers understand visa application processes and travel options.

## Main website
- https://nextvis.netlify.app/

## Services
- Visa application assistance and consultations
- Destination-specific visa guidance
- International tours and travel planning

For visa requirements, fees, eligibility, and processing times, travelers should verify the latest information with official government and consular sources.
